annotation.title_clean: A Study on the Improvement of the Intelligent Robots Act
annotation.title_en: A Study on the Improvement of the Intelligent Robots Act
annotation.venue: Journal of The Korea Society of Computer and Information
named_instruments_referenced: EU Civil Law Rules on Robotics 2017
annotation.summary_en: Korean legal-doctrinal article proposing reforms to the Intelligent Robots Act: legal personality ("electronic human being") for AI robots in patent infringement, separating injunction (robot) from monetary liability (owner), criminal penalties for manufacturers via amending Article 47, and contact-based safety tiers with registration and licensing.
key_provisions_or_claims: Grant AI robots legal personality as subject of patent infringement; injunction against robot, compensation by owner.
Amend Article 47 penal provisions to punish robot manufacturers and companies with joint penal provisions.
Tier safety regulation by degree of human contact; registration, inspection and licensing for high-contact robots.
Legislate user authentication and information security standards for remotely controlled robots.
Consider UK-style corporate manslaughter law for serious robot accidents.
